context_text:
# Release Tracker

## Notes

The team held the release check-in after lunch because several people were busy in the morning.
Priya mentors Omar during the release cycle and usually reviews his rollout notes before they go to the wider group.
Nina coordinates search-related launch checks with Marco, especially when the checklist touches billing or reporting.
Lena asked Iris to review the mobile analytics dashboard before beta, but that discussion was mostly about chart labels.
The infrastructure team mentioned that the staging cluster looked healthy after the latest cache change.
Security review follows the project owned by Omar's mentor, and the review is tracked separately from the normal launch checklist.
Finance review follows the project owned by Marco because the billing team wants one more look at the release evidence.
Several people agreed to keep the daily update short unless a blocker appears before the next milestone.
The design team asked for screenshots after the next build, but no design decision changed the release tracker.

## Table

| Project | Owner | Current Status | Risk Level | Next Milestone | Target Date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Atlas Search | Nina | API contract finalized | Low | Load test | Apr 18 |
| Beacon Sync | Omar | Waiting for schema review | Medium | Migration rehearsal | Apr 22 |
| Cedar Auth | Priya | Token rotation bug found | High | Security patch | Apr 16 |
| Delta Billing | Marco | Invoice retry logic verified | Low | Finance sign-off | Apr 25 |
| Echo Mobile | Lena | Beta crash reports under review | Medium | TestFlight build | Apr 19 |
| Fennel Analytics | Iris | Dashboard filters redesigned | Low | UX review | Apr 23 |
